name: Connie Anderson
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 10B

items.text: Connie Anderson was appointed to the Chicago Board of Education in July 2026 to represent District 10B. She works as a paralegal. She co-founded The Record Track, a South Side arts business. She led the development of three student robotics teams for Chicago Public Schools. She served as an executive member of Friends of Ogden and was involved in the 2018 Ogden/Jenner school merger.

sentences.text: Connie Anderson was appointed to the Chicago Board of Education in July 2026 to represent District 10B.
She co-founded The Record Track, a South Side arts business.
She led the development of three student robotics teams for Chicago Public Schools.
She served as an executive member of Friends of Ogden and was involved in the 2018 Ogden/Jenner school merger.

items.text: She says her first priority is fully funding special education and supporting students with disabilities. She supports expanding career and technical education and arts programming. She also supports improving school facilities. She opposes charter schools. She has said declining enrollment is an opportunity to strengthen schools.
